author: NorthEast News Desk
body: Tiverton returned to varsity football as the first regular-season Friday night brought a full slate of high school games across Southern New England. Sports Team 10’s Week 1 roundup featured action from nine matchups involving Rhode Island and nearby Massachusetts programs.

The schedule included Johnston and East Providence, Davies and Lincoln, Saint Raphael and Cumberland, Barrington and Burrillville, and Tiverton and Smithfield. Classical, Woonsocket, Mount Pleasant, Coventry, Attleboro, Seekonk and Old Colony were also represented in the evening’s coverage. The broad opening-night card gave teams their first meaningful test after preseason preparation.

Tiverton’s return was a notable part of the night because it restored another local program to the statewide football calendar. Week 1 results are only an early measure, but opening games begin to establish rotations, identify areas for improvement and shape divisional races. The Friday slate also restored the familiar rhythm of community football under the lights, with multiple schools beginning campaigns at the same time across the region. Teams now turn quickly toward film review and their second-week opponents.
dek: Nine matchups opened the regular-season Friday-night schedule, with Tiverton’s return highlighting the Southern New England slate.
headline: Tiverton returns as Southern New England football opens Week 1
